name: Scattering Lab
description: The virtual scattering lab: measures the random-incidence scattering and diffusion coefficients of a sample in the octave bands by physical optics (Kirchhoff). A run takes minutes and starts only when Run is pressed.

inputParameters.name: preset
inputParameters.description: Optional. The measurement's size: 'survey' (13 sources), 'standard' (97) or 'fine' (864); empty is standard.

inputParameters.name: run
inputParameters.description: Press to run; a run takes minutes and runs only when this is true; a button is added when it is not connected. Press again to run again with the same inputs.

outputParameters.name: scattering
outputParameters.description: Scattering coefficient of the 7 material octave bands, 125 to 8000 Hz (an octave that was not simulated is filled from the nearest one). Pairs with the bands of Lab Material, not with diffusion.

outputParameters.name: diffusion
outputParameters.description: Normalised diffusion coefficient d_n = (d - d_ref) / (1 - d_ref) (ISO 17497-2) of each simulated octave band, which can be negative. It pairs with 'octaves' (6 bands with the ISO range), not with 'scattering'.

outputParameters.name: octaves
outputParameters.description: The simulated octave bands, in Hz; one value of 'diffusion' for each.
